posting.title: Lead Data Scientist
posting.description:
About the role:
Nordhavn Bank is a Danish retail and investment bank with a large online gambling-adjacent payments arm. We are hiring a Lead Data Scientist to build credit-risk and fraud models for the bank.

Responsibilities:
You will lead a team of data scientists, set the technical direction, own forecasting and machine learning models end to end in Python and SQL, and report to the CTO.

Requirements:
8+ years of experience in data science with at least 3 years leading a team. Strong Python, SQL, MLOps and stakeholder-management skills.

Location and work mode:
Hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, two days a week at home.

What we offer:
Competitive salary and a collaborative team.

config.sectors: I want a medical or green energy company, or maybe robotics. Avoid sectors like banking and gambling.
